purpose: Download, align, audit, and deterministically select 24 ESR1 receptor candidates for cognate redocking without reading docking outcomes or held-out rows.

reference.pocket_derivation: wild-type chain-A standard amino-acid residues with a heavy atom within 6.0 A of any E4D heavy atom
reference.anchor_derivation: the reference-pocket subset with a heavy atom within 4.0 A of any E4D heavy atom

coordinate_gate.chain_identifier: author chain from the frozen metadata candidate CSV
coordinate_gate.alternate_location_rule: highest occupancy, then blank, A, and lexical tie-break
coordinate_gate.alignment: proper-rotation Kabsch alignment using same-number, same-residue-name protein C-alpha atoms
coordinate_gate.global_incomplete_residue_policy: record only during structural selection; before preparation, require a prospectively frozen preparation-readiness rule without reading docking scores

features: pairwise ligand-pocket side-chain heavy-atom centroid distances
structural_selection.standardization: feature-wise z score over all coordinate-eligible structures, then division by the square root of retained feature count
structural_selection.selection_rule: deterministic max-min structural distance seeded by ESR1_1SJ0_reference; ties resolved by lexical conformer ID
structural_selection.failure_action: stop before receptor preparation, redocking, production docking, QUBO fitting, validation sampling, or validation access if fewer than 24 structures pass

interpretation_boundary: Passing this gate establishes only a structurally diverse, label-independent ESR1 receptor candidate pool. Receptor preparation and three-seed cognate redocking remain mandatory before benchmark docking; no enrichment, QUBO, quantum-application, or quantum-advantage conclusion follows.
